title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
authors: Nicolas Carion, Francisco Massa, Gabriel Synnaeve, Nicolas Usunier, Alexander Kirillov, Sergey Zagoruyko
annotation: Introduces the DEtection TRansformer (DETR) architecture, replacing handcrafted anchors and non-maximum suppression (NMS) with direct set prediction and bipartite Hungarian matching loss.

title: Deformable DETR: Deformable Transformers for End-to-End Object Detection
authors: Xizhou Zhu, Weijie Su, Lewei Lu, Bin Li, Xiaogang Wang, Jifeng Dai
annotation: Resolves DETR slow convergence and high computational complexity by attending only to a small set of key sampling points around reference locations across multi-scale feature pyramids.

title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
authors: Tsung-Yi Lin, Priya Goyal, Ross Girshick, Kaiming He, Piotr Dollar
publisher: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)
annotation: Proposes the focal loss formulation and the RetinaNet architecture, demonstrating that dynamically scaled cross-entropy addresses severe class imbalance in one-stage dense visual detection.

title: Generalized Intersection over Union: A Metric and A Loss for Bounding Box Regression
authors: Hamid Rezatofighi, Nathan Tsoi, Jianwei Stan Choi, Amar Shah, Silvio Savarese
publisher: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Formulates Generalized IoU (GIoU), resolving the vanishing gradient limitation of standard IoU when predicted and ground-truth bounding boxes have zero intersection.
